title: Land promotion-guards.yml (dev-to-main manual-fast-forward guardrails)
summary: Step 1 of 5 in the user-approved main-branch migration (opum-agent OPAG-69 successor, user decision via opum-agent: opum-marketplace gets a main and a promotion gate like every other repo). Adds .github/workflows/promotion-guards.yml, copying the two-job pattern from opum-agent's own file (read read-only) verbatim in shape, adapted only in repo-specific wording: promotion-is-manual (fails on purpose on any PR into main, steering away from the merge button) and main-is-fast-forward-of-dev (fails a push to main whose new HEAD is not a commit dev already held). Own trigger file, own on: pull_request/push scoped to branches: [main] -- not folded into ci.yml behind an if:, which is the exact mistake opum-doc ODOC-155 had to correct after discovering the push-side guard had never actually fired through several real promotions. Neither job becomes a required status check: GitHub gates a direct push by the pushed commit's own prior check history regardless of which event produced it, and a job scoped to pull_request/push against main never reports for dev's tip in any other context -- requiring it would make the one correct promotion path (git push origin dev:main) permanently unpushable. Land on dev before main exists, so the file is already present in dev's tree when main is created in step 3 (OMARK-31).

acceptanceCriteria.text: promotion-guards.yml matches opum-agent's two-job shape (names, the ancestor check, the trigger scope) with only repo-specific text changed -- not reinvented.
Neither job is added to any required-status-checks configuration in this task -- that is OMARK-30's job, and mixing them risks the exact trap documented in opum-doc's runbook.
File lands on dev via the normal branch/PR path before main exists, so it is already part of dev's tree at the moment main is first created.

implementationNotes: Copied opum-agent's two jobs verbatim in shape (names, ancestor check, trigger scope on branches: [main]), changing only comment wording to cite this repo's own task ids and both source documents. Validated YAML locally before committing. Confirmed check . manifests would not fire: diff scope against skills/hooks/agents/commands/plugin.json is empty.
